title.en: Tale 7 — Dimna Speaks to the Ox

sentences.ar: طلع دمنة من عند الأسد، وراح على طول عند شتربة.
sentences.en: Dimna left the lion, and went straight to Shatraba.

sentences.ar: الثور كان قاعد بالمرج بياكل، ولما شافه فرح.
sentences.en: The ox was in the meadow eating, and when he saw him he was glad.

sentences.ar: قال: يا دمنة، صاحبي الأول بالغابة!
sentences.en: He said: Dimna, my first friend in the forest!
Where have you been?

sentences.ar: دمنة قعد جنبه، وعمل حاله حزين، ونفس الشغلة.
sentences.en: Dimna sat beside him, made himself look sad, and did the same thing.
Shatraba said: what is wrong?

sentences.ar: قال دمنة: أنا صاحبك، وعشان هيك جيت أحذرك.
sentences.en: Dimna said: I am your friend, and that is why I came to warn you.
The lion wants to be rid of you.

sentences.ar: سمعته بيقول للوزرا: الثور صار سمين.
sentences.en: I heard him say to the ministers: the ox has grown fat.
And tomorrow I invite you to his meat.
Shatraba stood where he was, and said: impossible.
He is my friend.
Dimna said: a lion is a lion.
He eats meat, and you are meat.

sentences.ar: الصداقة بينكم كانت لعبة، ولما تخلص اللعبة، بيرجع لطبعه.
sentences.en: The friendship between you was a game, and when the game ends, he goes back to his nature.
Shatraba did not believe it at first.

sentences.ar: قال: أنا ما عملت له إشي.
sentences.en: He said: I have done nothing to him.
Why would he kill me?

sentences.ar: قال دمنة: الملوك ما بيحتاجوا سبب.
sentences.en: Dimna said: kings do not need a reason.

sentences.ar: وبعدين، لاحظ لما تشوفه المرة الجاية.
sentences.en: And then, watch when you see him the next time.

sentences.ar: إذا إجا وعينه حمرا وديله بيضرب الأرض؟
sentences.en: If he comes with his eyes red and his tail beating the ground?
Then know he means you harm.

sentences.ar: قال شتربة: وإذا كان هيك، شو أعمل؟
sentences.en: Shatraba said: and if it is so, what do I do?
Dimna said: defend yourself.
You are big and your horns are sharp.

sentences.ar: طلع دمنة، وترك الثور لحاله بالمرج.
sentences.en: Dimna left, and left the ox alone in the meadow.
Shatraba did not sleep that night.
Every time he heard a sound, he stood up.

sentences.ar: وبالطرف التاني من الغابة، الأسد كمان ما نام.
sentences.en: And on the other side of the forest, the lion did not sleep either.

sentences.ar: كل واحد فيهم صار خايف من التاني.
sentences.en: Each of them had become afraid of the other.

sentences.ar: ورجع دمنة عند كليلة وقال: خلص، زرعت.
sentences.en: And Dimna went back to Kalila and said: it is done, I have sown.
Kalila said: and what will you reap?
Dimna did not answer.
